name: First Valentine's Day Date
source:
First Valentine’s Day Date (FVDD) is the first prequel of the upcoming relaunch of A Very Small Business (AVSB), called My Life with Laura (MLwL).

FVDD not only reintroduces the main couple, but it also introduces several characters that will have major roles within My Life with Laura.

The male protagonist has planned a surprise for his beloved Laura by inviting her to their first Valentine’s Day dinner date in an upscale restaurant of Trinity.
But this dinner date is not the real surprise for Laura, as this is rather something way more personal that will show her his deep and sincere love for her.
Laura too has prepared a surprise for the love of her life, later on; a naughty surprise that will stun our protagonist in awe and fill him with lust.
For all who want a little teaser about this naughty surprise: It has something to do with a hard pole.
translation:
《第一次情人节约会》(FVDD) 是即将重新推出的《小生意》(AVSB) 的第一部前传，名为《我与劳拉的生活》(MLwL)。

FVDD不仅重新引入了主要情侣，还引入了几位将在《我与劳拉的生活》中扮演重要角色的角色。

男主角计划给心爱的劳拉一个惊喜，邀请她在三一高档餐厅参加他们的第一次情人节晚餐约会。
但这次晚餐约会对劳拉来说并不是真正的惊喜，因为这是更私人的事情，将向她展示他对她深切而真诚的爱。
随后，劳拉也为她一生的挚爱准备了一个惊喜。一个调皮的惊喜会让我们的主角感到敬畏并充满欲望。
对于所有想了解一下这个顽皮惊喜的人：它与一根硬杆有关。
